_help: 1 coin = +30 HP (giftMultiplier). A like or a comment joins once at likeHp. Follows give nothing. 30 fight at once, 80 reserved seats (fixed). FINAL RUSH = last finalRushSeconds, hits x suddenDeathDamage. Boss every bossEvery seconds for bossSeconds. timeUpRanking: 'hp' = most HP wins at 0:00 (shown rule); 'effective' = HP divided by the gift damage multiplier (fairer to free players). Gift fairness: damage taken x maxHp/effHp, effHp = 120*(1+0.6*log2(maxHp/120)) above 120 HP. ?split=0 keeps one arena.
